name: Opus — five or more mana spent replaces the +1/+1 on a fired trigger
notes: Sweep theme 7 (2026-10-06). Deluge Virtuoso's Opus trigger: "this creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn. If five or more mana was spent to cast that spell, this creature gets +2/+2 until end of turn instead." The second sentence produced nothing. A fired trigger now carries the same toggle a spell does; with it on the Virtuoso (2/2) is 4/4, not 3/3 and not 5/5.
